source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Press "F11" when the hint shows up during POST. Check the information and see if SUT could boot into BIOS setup menu.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. POST information (include BIOS version and release date) should be readable and correct.
2. SUT should boot into BIOS setup menu successfully.

historical_reviews.deepseek: NO; correctly identifies physical pre-OS action.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY / IMPROVED; highlights platform-specific F11 target and exact menu evidence.

original_test_intent: Verify the F11 POST hint and key path reaches the source-required BIOS Setup target, with readable/correct BIOS version and release date.
original_method: Confirm this board's documented F11 mapping rather than assuming a generic boot-menu function, use physical console input at the hint, capture the exact target and displayed values, and exit safely.
manual_activity: A human must press F11 during POST and visually identify the exact pre-OS menu plus version/date. No SSH or inventory result proves the F11 mapping.
required_inputs: Board/BIOS-specific F11 mapping and expected target
safety_requirements: Do not assume F11 opens BIOS Setup; many platforms map it differently.
Do not flood F11 or alter menu settings.
Stop on unexpected target, unreadable values or failed recovery.
agent_execution_scope: Prepare board mapping/version baselines and capture checklist.
Analyze supplied screen evidence and boot context.
Report evidence without claiming the manual key action or verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve window and press F11 at the displayed hint.
Identify/capture the exact target and version/date.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correct: SSH cannot prove F11 pre-OS behavior.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain physical F11 interaction; confirm board mapping before acceptance.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: F11, hint timing, source BIOS Setup target, version/date and 30/30-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record continuous evidence of the platform hint, F11 action, exact resulting menu, values and safe exit, with the board mapping attached.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The exact board/BIOS after F11 behavior is documented.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC, keyboard/display and capture metadata.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds mapping validation and exact target identification without changing the manual core.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A boot manager result cannot be called BIOS Setup unless the platform specification says so.

project_override_considerations: If platform F11 intentionally opens another target, owner must document whether source Setup expectation is overridden; the record must name the actual menu.
expected_evidence: Timestamped F11 and exact menu capture
Readable matching version/date and normal boot recovery

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source internally requires F11 to enter BIOS Setup. Possible platform variance is a required input, not an internal source contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Intent is explicit and manual; missing board mapping is readiness, not permanent blockage.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains platform-specific F11 mapping and MANUAL ONLY conclusion.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates board-spec readiness from classification and verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents copy-pasting F2 behavior onto F11 and requires proof of the exact menu reached.
independent_technical_reasoning: F11 mapping can materially differ from F2/Del, so this case was independently assessed. Its physical key and visual target remain MANUAL ONLY.

source_provenance.history: review_round_02_functionality.md exact-code entry and repository exact-code search

no_automatic_retry: Do not repeatedly reboot, flood F11 or choose a different target automatically.
